messages:
jamie: Quick sync — after the queueing refactor merged in PR #482 we saw token throughput drop on the p100 canary pool. Can someone run a focused continuous-batching throughput run? I'm thinking: max_batch_size=64, max_tokens=1024, queue_wait_ms=20, batch_window_ms=5. Please paste raw bench output. Tagging @nina for perf run. :eyes:

nina: On it. Which model + sequence lengths do you want? Start with a single-model 1024 run or a mixed profile (256/1024)?

jamie: Start with seq=1024 single-model gpt-j-70b-qa-quant to reproduce, then a mixed workload (50% 256 / 50% 1024). Use the bench script below and include p50/p95/p99 + avg_batch_size + tokens/sec.

```bash
# on canary nodes
./bench/continuous_run.py \ 
  --model gpt-j-70b-qa-quant \ 
  --gpu-pool p100 \ 
  --clients 32 \ 
  --max-batch 64 \ 
  --max-tokens 1024 \ 
  --duration 10m \ 
  --warmup 2m \ 
  --output raw.json
```

nina: Running now on canary-inference-2 (pinning nodes). ETA ~12m. I'll collect raw.json and perf profiles.

tom: FYI the p100 pool has some background training jobs this afternoon — good call pinning to canary-inference-2. Also the queue params landed under /etc/redwood/runtime/queue.conf if you want to toggle live.

kyle: Quick note — try enabling kv_cache_prefetch=true for the warm run. I suspect cold KV cache effects are hiding in the new queueing path. If you want a cold baseline, pass --clear-kv to the bench.

perf-bot: Baseline (master @ 1754300000): throughput=420 tok/s, p95=180ms, avg_batch_size=18.

nina: First pass results (single-model seq=1024): throughput=365 tok/s, p95=230ms, avg_batch_size=22. Mixed workload similar. Raw log: https://s3.redwood/profiler/1754500000/raw.json

jamie: That's a meaningful regression. Nina — can you rerun two quick variants: 1) warm-run with kv_cache_prefetch=true, 2) cold-run with --clear-kv (no prefetch) so we can compare warm vs cold behavior?

rachel: If this holds in safety tests, we should prepare a quick rollback plan. Rolling back the queueing refactor to the previous commit is low-risk and buys time. I can stage a rollback canary tomorrow morning.

nina: Reruns done: warm (kv_cache_prefetch=true) => throughput=430 tok/s, p95=170ms, avg_batch_size=24. Cold (--clear-kv) => throughput=340 tok/s, p95=250ms. Uploaded pprof: https://s3.redwood/profiler/1754500000/pprof.tar.gz

jamie: Interesting — warm performance is actually slightly better than baseline, cold is worse. That suggests prefetch ordering or initial batching path changed. Next actions: 1) kyle to inspect KV prefetch ordering and race conditions; 2) tom to review node scheduler and any interference on canary nodes; 3) nina to run a 1h full regression across p100/v100/a100. I'll open a ticket and link logs. Thanks team :thumbsup:

nina: Copy — starting the 1h runs now, will post results to the ticket when done.

jamie: Great, keeping this thread for notes. If anyone finds a quick mitigation (config flip, rollback patch) drop it here and we'll coordinate the canary.
